description: Canon 30D digital camera: the transmission of the camera's internal UV/IR-cut ('hot mirror') filter as measured by Kolari Vision on filters removed during full-spectrum conversions.
facility_description: Digital cameras (DSLRs, mirrorless, compact, industrial, cinema and phone cameras) whose RGB channel spectral sensitivities or internal IR/UV-cut filter transmissions have been measured.
notes: Block band: Kolari page has a chart titled 'Canon 30D (image file "Canon D30.jpg") ICF Transmission' (image chart only; the NJM curve is a digitization).
